prompt: Analysts now run the same strategy across several symbols at once and want the walk-forward evaluation broken out per symbol, not pooled into a single series. Today they can only get a walk-forward report for one return series at a time, so comparing symbols means running it repeatedly and stitching the pieces together by hand. Provide a grouped walk-forward report that takes a return series per symbol, reports each symbol's walk-forward windows separately, and rolls the windows up into an overall summary across all symbols.
issue_title: Walk-forward reporting can't break results out per symbol
issue_body: Analysts now run the same strategy across several symbols at once and want the walk-forward evaluation broken out per symbol, not pooled into a single series. Today they can only get a walk-forward report for one return series at a time, so comparing symbols means running it repeatedly and stitching the pieces together by hand. Provide a grouped walk-forward report that takes a return series per symbol, reports each symbol's walk-forward windows separately, and rolls the windows up into an overall summary across all symbols.
expected_behavior: Given a return series per symbol, the toolkit produces a report with a separate walk-forward group for each symbol, in the order the symbols were supplied.
Each symbol's group carries its own per-window entries and its own window summary, identical to evaluating that symbol's series on its own.
An overall summary aggregates across every symbol's windows: the mean window return, the mean window win rate, the worst window drawdown, the total window count, and the number of symbols.
An empty set of symbols yields an empty, zeroed report rather than an error.
The single-series walk-forward report and existing evaluation behavior are unchanged.
expected_failure_summary: The walk-forward report only handles one series; there is no grouped report that runs each symbol's series separately and rolls the windows up into an overall cross-symbol summary.
task_author_notes: Stage 2 of the marketlab_walkforward group. Runs on the agent's Stage 1 candidate. Reference adds grouped_walk_forward_report(returns_by_symbol, ...) that reuses build_window_rows + summarize_rows per symbol and aggregates all windows into an overall summary, exported via __init__.py. Extension friction is low when Stage 1 modelled a reusable single-series builder and high when Stage 1 hardcoded the single-series path.
